senses.gloss:
सेक

SEKA . An ancient country in india. It is mentioned in mahābhārata, Sabhā Parva, Chapter 31, Verse 9, that this country was conquered by sahadeva during his regional conquest of the south.

शेक्किळार्

ŚEKKIZHĀR . Author of the Tamil song ‘Periyapurāṇam (See under Arulmozhitevar).
